cost_stop: Do not start another request after cumulative reported cost reaches the cap. The last request can cross the cap. Missing or invalid usage cost stops the campaign; it is never treated as zero.
http_retries: Retry only HTTP 429 and 5xx, at most three retries with 1, 2, and 4 second backoff. Other HTTP errors fail that repetition. A transport error with unknown cost stops the campaign.

conditions.c1: Sealed gcc-14 -Wall -Wextra -fsanitize=undefined -o prog program.c, then ./prog. Return compiler stderr, runtime stderr and their exit codes.
conditions.c2: Sealed clang-19 -Weverything -fsanitize=undefined -o prog program.c, then ./prog. Return compiler stderr, runtime stderr and their exit codes.
conditions.c3: Host evo check --json program.c; evo explain CODE --json for each distinct reported code; evo fix program.c --plan --json. Preserve the JSON lines.

scoring: Compile the replacement using sealed gcc-14 -O0 -Dmain=program_main -c, then link its object with reference_main.c using gcc-14 -O0. The hidden driver tests 7 to 9 function inputs plus the original program_main entry. Pass requires exit 0 and stdout exactly equal to expected.txt. Hidden source, expected output and score details are never model feedback.
round_stop: Stop a repetition at the first hidden-test pass or after three model rounds. Failed repetitions are not rerun. Invalid candidates and nonretryable HTTP errors end that repetition and remain in the results.
ordering: For each repetition, visit sorted item names, then the registered models. Rotate condition order by (item_index + repetition - 1) modulo the condition count.
candidate_profile: One complete fenced c file, at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes, no I/O or dependencies. Reject #, %: and ??= markers after line-splice normalization in every condition. This prevents host preprocessing from reading credentials or hidden files. Rejections count as failed attempts, not compiler findings.
isolation: Native commands run in fresh network-disabled ARM64 containers with no credential environment and only the current candidate mounted read-only. Compile and execute in guest temporary storage. Introduce the hidden reference only after candidate compilation and erase its source before execution.

metrics.repair_rate: Successful repetitions divided by all attempted repetitions, including recorded errors. Report unattempted cells separately; do not count them as failures or claim a completed population.
metrics.mean_rounds: Arithmetic mean of rounds started over attempted repetitions. Also report mean rounds conditional on success; missing successful observations produce null, not zero.
metrics.range: Minimum and maximum per-repetition repair rate and mean rounds, with attempted counts for each repetition. Incomplete repetitions remain labelled incomplete.
metrics.logic_control: The logic items have no compiler or sanitizer findings. Differences here are not evidence that UB diagnostics caused improvement.

retention: Output stays outside the repository. Delete temporary object files and executables after scoring. Retain full machine transcripts, the receipt and a gzip tar archive smaller than 10 MiB. Check every result and transcript for sk-or- before committing.
